method: Frozen-backbone feature extraction + trained classifier head (linear probe), exported to ONNX
runtime: ONNX Runtime (CPU) - suitable for on-device / edge deployment
notes: int8 dynamic quantization shrank the model to 1.27 MB but collapsed accuracy to 2.8% (unsupported op handling), so the fp32 model is shipped. Static quantization with calibration data is a planned next step.
